obligations.text: Where the approval holder has informed it that production of an approved vehicle type has completely ceased, the Type Approval Authority which granted the approval shall forthwith inform the other Contracting Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1 to this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Same authority notification obligation as old clause 10 (o110); text identical.

coverage.source_unit: 11 – Contracting Parties shall communicate to the UN Secretariat names and addresses of Technical Services and Type Approval Authorities
Footnote 4 – description of UNECE online platform
coverage.exclusion_reason: Informational footnote describing the platform; not an obligation.

obligations.text: The Contracting Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation shall communicate to the United Nations Secretariat the names and addresses of the Technical Services responsible for conducting approval tests and of the Type Approval Authorities which grant approval and to which forms certifying approval or extension or refusal or withdrawal of approval are to be sent.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as old clause 11 (o111); only the footnote number changed (3 to 4).

coverage.source_unit: 12 – heading 'Transitional provisions'
12.1 – heading 'Transitional provisions applicable to the 01 series of amendments'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only, with no operative requirement in this clause text.

coverage.source_unit: 12.1.1 – whole paragraph: no Contracting Party shall refuse to grant or accept type approvals under the Regulation as amended by the 01 series from its entry into force

obligations.text: As from the official date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant or refuse to accept type approvals under this Regulation as amended by the 01 series of amendments.
obligations.reason: New transitional compliance obligation for Contracting Parties tied to the 01 series. Candidate old clauses (5.1.8, Annex 3/3.11, 7.3) concern different actors and subjects and are not equivalent.

coverage.source_unit: 12.1.2 – whole paragraph: from 1 September 2029 Contracting Parties not obliged to accept original-version approvals first issued after that date

obligations.text: As from 1 September 2029, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals to the original version of this Regulation first issued after 1 September 2029.
obligations.reason: New transitional provision (permission to refuse) with a specific date and scope. No old clause is a relocation or replacement of it (8.2, 9.2, 7.3 differ in scope).

coverage.source_unit: 12.1.3 – whole paragraph: until 1 September 2031 Contracting Parties shall accept original-version approvals first issued before 1 September 2029

obligations.text: Until 1 September 2031, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall accept type approvals to the original version of this Regulation first issued before 1 September 2029.
obligations.reason: New transitional acceptance obligation with its own dates. Candidates (9.2, 7.3, Annex 3/3.3.5.1) cover unrelated notification and identification matters.

coverage.source_unit: 12.1.4 – whole paragraph: from 1 September 2031 Contracting Parties not obliged to accept approvals issued to the original version

obligations.text: As from 1 September 2031, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals issued to the original version of this Regulation.
obligations.reason: New transitional cut-off permission. Candidates 7.2, 7.3 and 4.1 concern communication and granting of approvals and are not the same scoped obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 12.1.5 – whole paragraph: notwithstanding 12.1.4, continue to accept original-version approvals for vehicles not affected by the 01 series changes

obligations.text: Notwithstanding paragraph 12.1.4., Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall continue to accept type approvals issued according to the original version of this Regulation for vehicles which are not affected by the changes introduced by the 01 series of amendments.
obligations.reason: New exception to the 12.1.4 cut-off with its own applicability condition. No old clause covers it (7.2, 4.1, 5.1.8 differ in scope).

coverage.source_unit: 12.1.6 – whole paragraph: Contracting Parties starting to apply the Regulation after entry into force of the latest series are not obliged to accept approvals under preceding series

obligations.text: Notwithstanding the transitional provisions above, Contracting Parties who start to apply this Regulation after the date of entry into force of the most recent series of amendments are not obliged to accept type approvals granted in accordance with any of the preceding series of amendments to this Regulation.
obligations.reason: New transitional provision for new Contracting Parties. Candidates (10, 4.2, 7.2) address production discontinuation, approval numbering and communication, so equivalence is not established.

coverage.source_unit: 12.1.7 – permission for Contracting Parties to grant type approvals according to any preceding series of amendments

obligations.text: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation may grant type approvals according to any preceding series of amendments to this Regulation (transitional provision for the 01 series of amendments).
obligations.reason: New transitional permission for the 01 series. Candidates o109, o102 and o101 concern withdrawal notification and extension communication, which differ in actor, action and scope, so there is no evidence of equivalence.

coverage.source_unit: 12.1.8 – obligation to continue granting extensions of existing approvals to preceding series of amendments

obligations.text: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall continue to grant extensions of existing approvals to any preceding series of amendments to this Regulation (transitional provision for the 01 series of amendments).
obligations.reason: New transitional obligation. Candidates o109, o102 and o105 cover withdrawal notification, extension communication and conformity of production, which are different scopes. No evidence of equivalence.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 communication form – issuing administration, concerning (granted/extended/refused/withdrawn/discontinued), vehicle type regarding ACPE under UN Regulation No. [17X], approval number

obligations.text: The approval communication form shall follow the Annex 1 model (max format A4, 210 x 297 mm): issuing administration name; indication of approval granted, extended, refused, withdrawn or production definitively discontinued for a vehicle type regarding Acceleration Control for Pedal Error pursuant to UN Regulation No. [17X]; and the approval number.
obligations.reason: Identical Annex 1 communication form content and scope as old o112 (similarity 1.0), with the same paragraph retained.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 footnote 1 – distinguishing number of country granting/extending/refusing/withdrawing approval

obligations.text: The communication form shall give the distinguishing number of the country which has granted, extended, refused or withdrawn an approval (see approval provisions in the Regulation).
obligations.reason: Same footnote 1 of the Annex 1 communication form as old o113, unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 footnote 2 – strike out what does not apply
Annex 1 items 1 and 2 – trademark; type and trade name(s)

obligations.text: On the communication form, entries that do not apply shall be struck out.
obligations.reason: Same Annex 1 footnote 2 as old o114, unchanged.

obligations.text: The communication form shall state the trademark (item 1) and the type and trade name(s) (item 2).
obligations.reason: Same Annex 1 items 1 and 2 as old o114, unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 item 3 – name and address of manufacturer

obligations.text: The communication form shall state the name and address of the manufacturer (item 3).
obligations.reason: Same Annex 1 item 3 as old o115, unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 4: If applicable, name and address of manufacturer’s representative (information document entry)

obligations.text: The information document shall state, if applicable, the name and address of the manufacturer’s representative.
obligations.reason: Same information-document item as o116 (Annex 1 / 4), same paragraph number and identical wording; unchanged scope.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 5: Brief description of vehicle type (information document entry)

obligations.text: The information document shall include a brief description of the vehicle type.
obligations.reason: Same item as o117 (Annex 1 / 5), identical paragraph and wording; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 6: Statement whether vehicle is equipped with ACPE exempted from requirements (forward and/or rear): yes/no

obligations.text: The information document shall state (yes/no) whether the vehicle is equipped with ACPE that has been exempted from the relevant requirements (forward and/or rear direction) of this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Same item as o118 (Annex 1 / 6), identical paragraph and wording; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 6.1: If yes, details (conditional on ACPE exemption)

obligations.text: If the vehicle is equipped with ACPE exempted from the relevant requirements (forward and/or rear direction), the information document shall give details of the exemption.
obligations.reason: Same conditional item as o119 (Annex 1 / 6.1) under the same parent item o118; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 7: Date of submission of vehicle for approval

obligations.text: The information document shall state the date of submission of the vehicle for approval.
obligations.reason: Same item as o120 (Annex 1 / 7), identical paragraph and wording; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 8: Technical Service performing the approval tests

obligations.text: The information document shall identify the Technical Service performing the approval tests.
obligations.reason: Same item as o121 (Annex 1 / 8), identical paragraph and wording; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 9 - 'Date of report issued by that Service' communication form field

obligations.text: The approval communication form shall state the date of the report issued by the Technical Service (Annex 1, item 9).
obligations.reason: Same scoped form field and same paragraph number 9 as o122 (Annex 1 / 9); identical wording and context, not renumbered; o123 is a different field (report number).

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 10 - 'Number of report issued by that Service' communication form field

obligations.text: The approval communication form shall state the number of the report issued by the Technical Service (Annex 1, item 10).
obligations.reason: Same form field and paragraph number as o123 (Annex 1 / 10); unchanged wording and scope; o122 is the date field.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 11 - 'Approval granted/refused/extended/withdrawn' field with footnote 2 (strike out what does not apply)

obligations.text: The approval communication form shall indicate whether approval is granted, refused, extended or withdrawn, striking out what does not apply (Annex 1, item 11).
obligations.reason: Same field and paragraph number as o124 (Annex 1 / 11), including the footnote 2 instruction; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 12 - 'Place' field

obligations.text: The approval communication form shall state the place (Annex 1, item 12).
obligations.reason: Same field and paragraph number as o125 (Annex 1 / 12); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 13 - 'Date' field

obligations.text: The approval communication form shall state the date (Annex 1, item 13).
obligations.reason: Same field and paragraph number as o126 (Annex 1 / 13); unchanged. Annex 3 / 3.10 is a different test-date field.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 14 - 'Signature' field

obligations.text: The approval communication form shall be signed (Annex 1, item 14).
obligations.reason: Same field and paragraph number as o127 (Annex 1 / 14); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 15. Annexed documents list bearing the approval number (communication form item)

obligations.text: The approval communication shall list, in item 15, the documents annexed to it, bearing the approval number indicated in the communication.
obligations.reason: Same communication form item 15 renumbered/relocated identically; matches o128 with identical text and scope (Annex 1 / 15).

coverage.source_unit: 16. Any remarks: (communication form item, blank field)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Blank form field for remarks; no engineering or compliance obligation.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 2 approval mark arrangement, a = 8 mm min, and explanation of mark meaning (see paragraphs 4.4 to 4.4.2)

obligations.text: The approval mark affixed to a vehicle shall conform to the Annex 2 arrangement with dimension a = 8 mm minimum, indicating approval (example: Belgium, E 6) with regard to Acceleration Control for Pedal Error (ACPE) pursuant to the UN Regulation, with the first two digits of the approval number showing approval in the original form of the Regulation.
obligations.reason: Identical Annex 2 text and scope as o130 (same annex, same pages content); no substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 3 title: Special requirements for safety aspects of electronic control systems
Annex 3 / 1 first paragraph: annex defines requirements for documentation, fault strategy and verification for Complex Electronic Vehicle Control Systems
Annex 3 / 1 second paragraph: annex also applies to safety related functions controlled by electronic systems
Annex 3 / 1 third paragraph: annex does not specify performance criteria; covers methodology and disclosed information
coverage.exclusion_reason: Descriptive statement of annex scope; no separate obligation.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 3 / 1 fourth paragraph: information shall show The System respects performance requirements under non-fault and fault conditions and does not induce safety critical risks

obligations.text: The documentation, fault strategy and verification requirements of Annex 3 shall be met with respect to the safety aspects of Complex Electronic Vehicle Control Systems, as far as this Regulation is concerned.
obligations.reason: Identical text to o132 (Annex 3 / 1) with same scope.

obligations.text: Annex 3 shall also apply to safety related functions identified in this Regulation that are controlled by electronic system(s), as far as this Regulation is concerned.
obligations.reason: Identical sentence in o132 (Annex 3 / 1) with same applicability.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall disclose to the Technical Service, for type approval, information showing that The System respects, under non-fault and fault conditions, all appropriate performance requirements of this Regulation and is designed to operate so that it does not induce safety critical risks.
obligations.reason: Identical sentence in o132 (Annex 3 / 1) with same actor and scope.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 3 / 2 heading: Definitions for the purposes of this annex
2.1 definition of "The System" (entire paragraph, incl. transmission links sentence)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; sets terminology and scope for the annex but imposes no engineering, test, or compliance requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2 definition of "Safety Concept"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; no mandatory action or test requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3 definition of "Electronic Control System"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; no mandatory action or test requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.4 definition of "Complex Electronic Vehicle Control Systems" (incl. 'shall also be included' sentence)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; the 'shall be included' wording defines the scope of the term, not a separate product or test obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 2.5 definition of "Higher-Level Electronic Control"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; no mandatory action or test requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.6 definition of "Units"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; no mandatory action or test requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.7 definition of "Transmission links" (whole paragraph)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; imposes no engineering, manufacturer, test or compliance requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.8 definition of "Range of control"
2.9 definition of "Boundary of functional operation"
2.10 definition of "Safety Related Function"
3. Documentation (heading)
3.1 first sentence: manufacturer shall provide documentation package giving access to basic design, links to other vehicle systems, and direct control of output variables
3.1 second sentence: function(s) of The System and safety concept shall be explained
3.1 third sentence: documentation brief yet evidencing expertise from all involved system fields
3.1 fourth sentence: for periodic technical inspections, documentation describes how operational status can be checked
3.1(a) Technical Service assessment: no safety critical risks under non-fault and fault conditions
3.1(b) Technical Service assessment: respects performance requirements under non-fault and fault conditions
3.1(c) Technical Service assessment: developed according to declared development process/method

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide a documentation package which gives access to the basic design of "The System" and the means by which it is linked to other vehicle systems or by which it directly controls output variables.
obligations.reason: Same scoped manufacturer documentation obligation, unchanged wording, relocated to new page; matches o145 (Annex 3 / 3.1).

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall explain the function(s) of "The System" and the safety concept, as laid down by the manufacturer, in the documentation package.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as o145 3.1 second sentence, unchanged.

obligations.text: The documentation shall be brief, yet provide evidence that the design and development has had the benefit of expertise from all the system fields which are involved.
obligations.reason: Same as o145 3.1 third sentence, unchanged.

obligations.text: For periodic technical inspections, the documentation shall describe how the current operational status of "The System" can be checked.
obligations.reason: Same as o145 3.1 fourth sentence, unchanged.

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall assess the documentation package to show that "The System" is designed to operate, under non-fault and fault conditions, in such a way that it does not induce safety critical risks.
obligations.reason: Same as o145 3.1(a), unchanged.

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall assess the documentation package to show that "The System" respects, under non-fault and fault conditions, all the appropriate performance requirements specified elsewhere in this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Same as o145 3.1(b), unchanged.

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall assess the documentation package to show that "The System" was developed according to the development process/method declared by the manufacturer.
obligations.reason: Same as o145 3.1(c), unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.1.1(a) formal documentation package (para 3 except 3.4.4) supplied to Technical Service at time of application
3.1.1(a) Technical Service uses package as basic reference for verification per paragraph 4
3.1.1(a) Technical Service ensures package remains available for agreed period, at least 10 years after production definitely discontinued
3.1.1(b) 3.4.4 material and analysis data retained by manufacturer and open for inspection at type approval
3.1.1(b) manufacturer ensures material remains available for 10 years after production discontinued

obligations.text: The formal documentation package for approval, containing the material listed in paragraph 3 of Annex 3 (except paragraph 3.4.4), shall be supplied to the Technical Service at the time of submission of the type approval application.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as o146 (3.1.1(a)), identical wording, same paragraph number; unchanged.

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall use the formal documentation package as the basic reference for the verification process set out in paragraph 4 of Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Matches o146 3.1.1(a) same paragraph, unchanged text and actor.

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall ensure the formal documentation package remains available for a period agreed with the Approval Authority, which shall be at least 10 years counted from the time production of the vehicle is definitely discontinued.
obligations.reason: Matches o146 3.1.1(a) retention duty, unchanged.

obligations.text: The additional material and analysis data of paragraph 3.4.4 shall be retained by the manufacturer and made open for inspection at the time of type approval.
obligations.reason: Matches o146 3.1.1(b), unchanged.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall ensure that the paragraph 3.4.4 material and analysis data remains available for 10 years counted from the time production of the vehicle is definitely discontinued.
obligations.reason: Matches o146 3.1.1(b) retention duty, unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2 description of all control functions, methods and control mechanism(s)
3.2 identify over-ridable functions and describe changed rationale

obligations.text: A description shall be provided giving a simple explanation of all the control functions of "The System" and the methods employed to achieve the objectives, including a statement of the mechanism(s) by which control is exercised.
obligations.reason: Identical to o147 3.2, same scope.

obligations.text: Any described function that can be over-ridden shall be identified and a further description of the changed rationale of the function's operation provided.
obligations.reason: Identical to o147 3.2 second paragraph.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2.1 list of input and sensed variables with working range

obligations.text: A list of all input and sensed variables shall be provided and the working range of these defined.
obligations.reason: Identical to o148 3.2.1, same scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2.2 list of output variables, direct or indirect control, range of control defined

obligations.text: A list of all output variables controlled by "The System" shall be provided, indicating in each case whether control is direct or via another vehicle system, and the range of control (paragraph 2.8) exercised on each variable shall be defined.
obligations.reason: Identical to o149 3.2.2, same scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2.3 limits defining boundaries of functional operation stated where appropriate

obligations.text: Limits defining the boundaries of functional operation (paragraph 2.9) shall be stated where appropriate to system performance.
obligations.reason: Identical to o150 3.2.3, same scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3 heading 'System layout and schematics'
3.3.1 para 1: list collating all units of The System and other vehicle systems needed for the control function
3.3.1 para 2: outline schematic showing units in combination with equipment distribution and interconnections

obligations.text: A list shall be provided collating all the units of "The System" and mentioning the other vehicle systems needed to achieve the control function in question.
obligations.reason: Same documentation obligation as old 3.3.1 under the same parent 3.3; unchanged wording and scope, renumbered page only.

obligations.text: An outline schematic showing the units of "The System" in combination shall be provided, with both the equipment distribution and the interconnections made clear.
obligations.reason: Same schematic obligation as old 3.3.1 second paragraph; continuity of paragraph number and parent context.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.2 sentence 1: function of each unit outlined and signals linking it with other units/systems shown; sentence 2 permits block diagram, schematic or description aided by diagram

obligations.text: The function of each unit of "The System" shall be outlined and the signals linking it with other units or other vehicle systems shall be shown; this may be provided by a labelled block diagram or other schematic, or by a description aided by such a diagram.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.3.2 in same parent context; same scoped obligation with unchanged content.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.3 sentence 1: interconnections within The System shown by circuit diagram (electric), piping diagram (pneumatic/hydraulic), simplified layout (mechanical)
3.3.3 sentence 2: transmission links to and from other systems shall also be shown

obligations.text: Interconnections within "The System" shall be shown by a circuit diagram for electric transmission links, by a piping diagram for pneumatic or hydraulic transmission equipment, and by a simplified diagrammatic layout for mechanical linkages.
obligations.reason: Same as old 3.3.3 in same parent; unchanged.

obligations.text: The transmission links both to and from other systems shall also be shown.
obligations.reason: Same as old 3.3.3 final sentence; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.4 sentence 1: clear correspondence between transmission links and signals/operating data
3.3.4 sentence 2: priorities of signals/operating data on multiplexed paths stated where priority affects performance or safety

obligations.text: There shall be a clear correspondence between the transmission links and the signals and/or operating data carried between units.
obligations.reason: Same as old 3.3.4 first sentence; unchanged apart from page break.

obligations.text: Priorities of signals and/or operating data on multiplexed data paths shall be stated wherever priority may be an issue affecting performance or safety as far as this Regulation is concerned.
obligations.reason: Same as old 3.3.4 second sentence; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.5 para 1: each unit clearly and unambiguously identifiable
3.3.5 para 2 sentence 1: combined functions in a single unit use only a single hardware identification marking
3.3.5 para 2 sentence 2: manufacturer affirms by identification that equipment conforms to document

obligations.text: Each unit shall be clearly and unambiguously identifiable (e.g. by marking for hardware and marking or software output for software content) to provide corresponding hardware and documentation association.
obligations.reason: Same as old 3.3.5 first paragraph; unchanged.

obligations.text: Where functions are combined within a single unit or single computer but shown in multiple blocks in the block diagram, only a single hardware identification marking shall be used.
obligations.reason: Same as old 3.3.5 combined-function rule; unchanged.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall, by use of the identification, affirm that the equipment supplied conforms to the corresponding document.
obligations.reason: Same as old 3.3.5 manufacturer affirmation; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.5.1: identification defines hardware and software version and shall be changed where software change alters unit function as far as this Regulation is concerned

obligations.text: The identification defines the hardware and software version and, where the software changes such as to alter the function of the unit as far as this Regulation is concerned, the identification shall also be changed.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.3.5.1 under the same parent 3.3.5; same scoped obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4. heading 'Safety concept of the manufacturer' (heading only)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; no obligation stated. Obligations are in subparagraphs 3.4.1-3.4.3.2.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.1 whole sentence: manufacturer statement affirming strategy will not prejudice safe operation under non-fault conditions

obligations.text: The Manufacturer shall provide a statement which affirms that the strategy chosen to achieve "The System" objectives will not, under non-fault conditions, prejudice the safe operation of the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation obligation (manufacturer statement on non-fault safe operation) renumbered/relocated unchanged from old 3.4.1 (o159), identical actor, action and conditions.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.2 sentence 1: software outline architecture explained and design methods and tools identified
3.4.2 sentence 2: manufacturer shall show evidence of means by which realisation of system logic was determined

obligations.text: In respect of software employed in "The System", the outline architecture shall be explained and the design methods and tools used shall be identified.
obligations.reason: Same software architecture/design tools documentation obligation as old 3.4.2 (o160), unchanged wording and scope.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall show evidence of the means by which they determined the realisation of the system logic, during the design and development process.
obligations.reason: Same evidence obligation as second sentence of old 3.4.2 (o160), unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3 main sentence: manufacturer shall provide Technical Service explanation of design provisions for safe operation under fault conditions (examples (a)-(c) are illustrative)
3.4.3 examples list (a) partial system, (b) back-up system, (c) removal of high level function
coverage.exclusion_reason: Illustrative examples of possible design provisions, not independent obligations.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3 'In case of a failure, the driver shall be warned...'
3.4.3 warning persistence while fault persists unless system deactivated by driver

obligations.text: The Manufacturer shall provide the Technical Service with an explanation of the design provisions built into "The System" so as to generate safe operation under fault conditions (possible provisions e.g. fall-back to partial system, change-over to separate back-up system, removal of the high level function).
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.4.3 (o161); same actor, recipient and object, relocated to new page only.

obligations.text: In case of a failure, the driver shall be warned, for example by warning signal or message display.
obligations.reason: Same driver-warning requirement in old 3.4.3 (o161), unchanged.

obligations.text: When the system is not deactivated by the driver (e.g. by turning the ignition (run) switch to "off", or by switching off that particular function if a special switch is provided for that purpose), the failure warning shall be present as long as the fault condition persists.
obligations.reason: Same warning persistence requirement in old 3.4.3 (o161), unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3.1 whole: if partial performance mode selected under fault conditions, state conditions and define limits of effectiveness

obligations.text: If the chosen provision selects a partial performance mode of operation under certain fault conditions, then these conditions shall be stated and the resulting limits of effectiveness defined.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.4.3.1 (o162) under same parent 3.4.3; same condition and action.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3.2 whole: if second (back-up) means selected, explain change-over principles, logic, redundancy level, back-up checking features and define limits of back-up effectiveness

obligations.text: If the chosen provision selects a second (back-up) means to realise the vehicle control system objective, the principles of the change-over mechanism, the logic and level of redundancy and any built in back-up checking features shall be explained and the resulting limits of back-up effectiveness defined.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.4.3.2 (o163) under same parent 3.4.3; same condition and action.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3.3 whole sentence: if removal of Higher Level Function is chosen, inhibit all associated output control signals limiting transition disturbance

obligations.text: If the chosen fault provision selects removal of the Higher Level Function, all output control signals associated with that function shall be inhibited, in such a manner as to limit the transition disturbance.
obligations.reason: Identical scoped obligation under the same parent 3.4.3 (fault design provisions); renumbering/page shift only; matches o164 in actor, action and condition.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.4 para 1: documentation supported by analysis of system behaviour on any individual hazard or fault
3.4.4 para 2: analytical approach established and maintained by Manufacturer, open for inspection at type approval
3.4.4 para 3: Technical Service assesses application of analytical approach(es); audit shall include (a)-(c) (lead-in)
3.4.4 (a) concept-level inspection based on Hazard/Risk analysis
3.4.4 (b) system-level inspection based on FMEA/FTA or similar
3.4.4 (c) inspection of validation plans and results
3.4.4 assessment consists of checks of hazards and faults chosen by Technical Service
3.4.4 last sentence: Technical Service may perform or require tests per paragraph 4

obligations.text: The documentation shall be supported by an analysis showing, in overall terms, how the system will behave on the occurrence of any individual hazard or fault that has a bearing on vehicle control performance or safety.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as o165 para 1, only renumbered page.

obligations.text: The Manufacturer shall establish and maintain the chosen analytical approach(es) and make them open for inspection by the Technical Service at the time of type approval.
obligations.reason: Same as o165 para 2.

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall perform an assessment of the application of the analytical approach(es), by an audit including items (a) to (c).
obligations.reason: Same as o165 para 3.

obligations.text: The audit shall include inspection of the safety approach at the concept (vehicle) level, confirming it considers interactions with other vehicle systems; this approach shall be based on a Hazard/Risk analysis appropriate to system safety.
obligations.reason: Same as o165 item (a).

obligations.text: The audit shall include inspection of the safety approach at the system level; this approach shall be based on a Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (FMEA), a Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) or any similar process appropriate to system safety.
obligations.reason: Same as o165 item (b).

obligations.text: The audit shall include inspection of the validation plans and results; validation shall use, for example, Hardware in the Loop (HIL) testing, vehicle on-road operational testing, or any means appropriate for validation.
obligations.reason: Same as o165 item (c).

obligations.text: The assessment shall consist of checks of hazards and faults chosen by the Technical Service to establish that the manufacturer's explanation of the safety concept is understandable and logical and that the validation plans are suitable and have been completed.
obligations.reason: Same as o165 assessment paragraph.

obligations.text: The Technical Service may perform, or may require to be performed, tests as specified in paragraph 4 of this annex to verify the safety concept.
obligations.reason: Same permission as o165 last sentence.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.4.1 whole: documentation itemizes monitored parameters and sets out warning signal per fault condition

obligations.text: The documentation shall itemize the parameters being monitored and shall set out, for each fault condition of the type defined in paragraph 3.4.4 of this annex, the warning signal to be given to the driver and/or to service/technical inspection personnel.
obligations.reason: Identical to o166 under same parent 3.4.4; no change in scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.4.2 whole: documentation describes measures for safe operation when performance affected by environmental conditions

obligations.text: The documentation shall describe the measures in place to ensure "The System" does not prejudice the safe operation of the vehicle when its performance is affected by environmental conditions, e.g. climatic, temperature, dust ingress, water ingress, ice packing.
obligations.reason: Identical to o167 under same parent 3.4.4.

coverage.source_unit: 4. Verification and test (heading)
4.1 functional operation of The System as laid out in paragraph 3 documents shall be tested as follows (lead-in)

obligations.text: The functional operation of "The System", as laid out in the documents required in paragraph 3 of this annex, shall be tested as follows.
obligations.reason: Identical to o169 under the same parent Annex 3 / 4; renumbering/page shift only.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.1 first paragraph: Technical Service verifies The System under non-fault conditions by testing selected functions from those declared in 3.2
4.1.1 second paragraph: for complex electronic systems, tests include scenarios where a declared function is overridden

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall verify "The System" under non-fault conditions by testing a number of selected functions from those declared by the manufacturer in paragraph 3.2 of Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Same scoped test obligation as old Annex 3 / 4.1.1 (o170), identical wording, renumbering only in page; same actor, object and scope.

obligations.text: For complex electronic systems, the Technical Service's verification tests of "The System" under non-fault conditions shall include scenarios whereby a declared function is overridden.
obligations.reason: Same complex-electronic-system override scenario requirement as old o170, same scope and unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.2 first sentence: check reaction of The System under failure in any individual unit by applying output signals to simulate internal faults
4.1.2 second sentence: Technical Service conducts the check for at least one individual unit, not multiple simultaneous failures
4.1.2 last paragraph: Technical Service verifies tests include HMI/controllability aspects

obligations.text: The reaction of "The System" shall be checked under the influence of a failure in any individual unit, by applying corresponding output signals to electrical units or mechanical elements to simulate the effects of internal faults within the unit (verification of the safety concept of paragraph 3.4).
obligations.reason: Same as old Annex 3 / 4.1.2 (o171), identical scope and wording.

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall conduct the failure-reaction check for at least one individual unit, but shall not check the reaction of "The System" to multiple simultaneous failures of individual units.
obligations.reason: Same as old o171 scope-limiting test requirement, unchanged.

obligations.text: The Technical Service shall verify that the safety concept failure tests include aspects that may have an impact on vehicle controllability and user information (HMI aspects).
obligations.reason: Same as old o171 final paragraph, unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.2.1 verification results shall correspond with documented failure analysis summary so safety concept and execution are confirmed adequate

obligations.text: The verification results shall correspond with the documented summary of the failure analysis, to a level of overall effect such that the safety concept and execution are confirmed as being adequate.
obligations.reason: Identical to old Annex 3 / 4.1.2.1 (o172) with same parent scope.

coverage.source_unit: 5 first paragraph: Technical Service reporting shall allow traceability, e.g. coded and listed document versions
5 second paragraph: example layout of assessment form in Appendix 1
coverage.exclusion_reason: Informative example, not a mandatory requirement

coverage.source_unit: Appendix 1 model form heading and Test report No / 1. Identification

obligations.text: Reporting of the assessment by the Technical Service shall be performed in such a manner that allows traceability, e.g. versions of documents inspected are coded and listed in the records of the Technical Service.
obligations.reason: Same as old Annex 3 / 5 (o173), unchanged requirement and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 1.1 Vehicle make: form field in model assessment form
coverage.exclusion_reason: Blank form field template entry, not an engineering or compliance obligation

coverage.source_unit: 1.2 Type: form field in model assessment form
coverage.exclusion_reason: Blank form field template entry, not an engineering or compliance obligation

coverage.source_unit: 1.3. Means of identification of type if marked on the vehicle: ...............

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 information document, state the means of identification of the type if marked on the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Same scoped item as old clause o176 (Annex 3 / 1.3) with the same paragraph number, identical wording and the same parent General context; no substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: 1.4. Location of that marking: ...............

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 information document, state the location of the type identification marking on the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Same scoped item as old clause o177 (Annex 3 / 1.4), with identical wording, same paragraph number and same parent context.

coverage.source_unit: 1.5. Manufacturer’s name and address: ...............

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 information document, state the manufacturer’s name and address.
obligations.reason: Same scoped item as old clause o178 (Annex 3 / 1.5) under the same Annex 3 / 1 parent; the Annex 1 / 3 candidate is a different document scope.

coverage.source_unit: 1.6. If applicable, name and address of manufacturer’s representative: ...............

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 information document, if applicable, state the name and address of the manufacturer’s representative.
obligations.reason: Same scoped item as old clause o179 (Annex 3 / 1.6) with identical wording and the same parent context; Annex 1 / 4 is a different document.

coverage.source_unit: 1.7 Manufacturer’s formal documentation package: documentation reference No, date of original issue, date of latest update
2.1 General description
2.2 Description of all control functions of The System and methods of operation
2.3 Description of components and interconnection diagrams within The System
3.1 Description of signal flow and operating data and their priorities
3.2 Manufacturer’s declaration that the strategy will not, under non-fault conditions, prejudice safe operation of the vehicle
3.3 Software outline architecture and design methods and tools used
3.4 Explanation of design provisions built into The System under fault conditions

obligations.text: Identify the manufacturer’s formal documentation package by documentation reference No., date of original issue and date of latest update.
obligations.reason: Same content as old clause o180 (Annex 3 / 1.7) under the same parent; unchanged.

obligations.text: Provide a general description of the test vehicle(s)/system(s) in the documentation package.
obligations.reason: Item 2.1 is in o180 with identical wording; unchanged.

obligations.text: Provide a description of all the control functions of "The System" and its methods of operation.
obligations.reason: Item 2.2 is in o180 with identical wording; unchanged.

obligations.text: Provide a description of the components of "The System" and diagrams of the interconnections within it.
obligations.reason: Item 2.3 is in o180 with identical wording; unchanged.

obligations.text: Provide a description of signal flow and operating data and their priorities as part of the manufacturer’s safety concept.
obligations.reason: Item 3.1 is in o180 with identical wording; unchanged.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall declare that the strategy chosen to achieve "The System" objectives will not, under non-fault conditions, prejudice the safe operation of the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Item 3.2 is in o180 with identical wording; unchanged.

obligations.text: Provide the software outline architecture and the design methods and tools used.
obligations.reason: Item 3.3 is in o180 with identical wording; unchanged.

obligations.text: Provide an explanation of the design provisions built into "The System" under fault conditions.
obligations.reason: Item 3.4 is in o180 with identical wording; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5. Documented analyses of the behaviour of The System under individual hazard or fault conditions

obligations.text: Provide documented analyses of the behaviour of "The System" under individual hazard or fault conditions.
obligations.reason: Same item as old clause o181 (Annex 3 / 3.5) with identical wording under the Documentation parent; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.6 Description of the measures in place for environmental conditions (documentation form field)

obligations.text: The documentation package shall include a description of the measures in place for environmental conditions.
obligations.reason: Same documentation field as old Annex 3 / 3.6 (o182) with identical wording, same parent Documentation section; only page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 3.7 Provisions for the periodic technical inspection of "The System" (documentation form field)

obligations.text: The documentation package shall include the provisions for the periodic technical inspection of "The System".
obligations.reason: Identical to old Annex 3 / 3.7 (o183), same scope and parent; renumbering of page only.

coverage.source_unit: 3.8 Results of "The System" verification test per para. 4.1.1 of Annex 3 (documentation form field)

obligations.text: The documentation shall include the results of "The System" verification test, as per para. 4.1.1. of Annex 3 to UN Regulation No. [17X].
obligations.reason: Identical to old Annex 3 / 3.8 (o184), same test reference and parent scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.9 Results of safety concept verification test per para. 4.1.2 of Annex 3 (documentation form field)

obligations.text: The documentation shall include the results of the safety concept verification test, as per para. 4.1.2. of Annex 3 to UN Regulation No. [17X].
obligations.reason: Identical to old Annex 3 / 3.9 (o185), same test reference (4.1.2) and parent scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.10 Date of test (documentation form field)

obligations.text: The test report documentation shall state the date of the test.
obligations.reason: Identical to old Annex 3 / 3.10 (o186), same field in the same Documentation section.

coverage.source_unit: 3.11 Statement that the test was carried out and results reported in accordance with UN Regulation No. [17X] as amended, with signature and date (form field)

obligations.text: The test report shall include a signed and dated statement that the test has been carried out and the results reported in accordance with the specified paragraph of UN Regulation No. [17X] as last amended by the stated series of amendments.
obligations.reason: Identical to old Annex 3 / 3.11 (o187), same attestation and signature/date content under the same parent.

coverage.source_unit: 3.13. Comments: ............... (blank form field in test report documentation)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Blank form field for comments in the communication/test report template; it imposes no engineering, test, or compliance requirement.
